title: WHAT IF YOU

youtube.title: What If You Never Slept Again?
tags: what happens if you don't sleep
youtube.intro:
One night, your brain simply stops feeling tired. Eight free hours, every single night. Homework done by midnight, a new hobby by two, breakfast for the whole family by six. But feeling tired and needing sleep are two different things, and your body keeps its own clock. Here's what really happens, hour by hour and day by day, if you never sleep again.

This is an original animated story. It's not medical advice: please don't try staying awake at home.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you take 8 free hours every night if you knew the price? 👇

The science checks out: after 17-19 hours awake your reaction times match a blood alcohol level of 0.05%, one sleepless night cuts your ability to store new memories by about 40%, and Randy Gardner really stayed awake for 11 days and 25 minutes in 1963-64. Sources are in the description.
